source_title: 유입 필독) 흑마 고르면 겪을 일들jpg
subtitle: 3시간 조각 파밍 → 소환·생명석 수발 → 정작 딜 체급은 평균 B티어 비애

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
레이드 3시간 전...
가방 4개 싹 비우고
영혼의 조각 100개 파밍 중...
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle shot looking down at the exhausted Human Warlock girl on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background (no scenery, no floor shading, no gray backdrop, no panel borders, zero text, zero letters, zero digits, zero speech bubbles, zero UI frames). In the lower-center, the Warlock girl (dark purple hood, jet-black twintails, violet eyes) crouches on the floor, surrounded by four bulging open leather backpacks literally overflowing with dozens of glowing violet-purple crystal soul shards, sweat streaming down her weary face (grumpy red plush imp doll sitting on the floor beside her). Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, leaving generous pure #FFFFFF headroom across top 38%.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
마을 수다 재밌었다~
이제 레이드 가볼까?
흑마님! 나 소환 좀~
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile 90-degree action shot on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background (no scenery, no floor shading, no gray backdrop, no panel borders, zero text, zero letters, zero digits, zero speech bubbles, zero UI frames). Positioned on the right half facing left, the Orc Warrior girl lounges back raising a rustic wooden tavern mug with a carefree grin (chunky silver battle axe strapped on back), while the Skyborne Mage relaxes happily nibbling a warm round conjured bread bun, yelling across the frame for a summon. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale filling ~65% of canvas height, leaving the left 48% empty pure white space.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
소환 감사해요 흑마님!
아, 생명석 사탕도
하나만 거래해 주세요~
cuts.visual_prompt: Dramatic low-angle shot looking up at the portal on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background (no scenery, no floor shading, no gray backdrop, no panel borders, zero text, zero letters, zero digits, zero speech bubbles, zero UI frames). On the lower-left, the sweaty exhausted Human Warlock channels a swirling violet-purple summoning vortex rift with one hand and extends an emerald-green crystal healthstone in the other (imp doll on floor); on the lower-right, the Mage steps cheerfully out of the glowing portal with an outstretched hand! Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, top 38% pure white.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
사탕자판기 수발 끝!
자, 이제 레이드 시작!
근데 흑마 딜 체급은... B티어?
cuts.visual_prompt: Tilted dutch-tilt diagonal angle on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background (no scenery, no floor shading, no gray backdrop, no panel borders, zero text, zero letters, zero digits, zero speech bubbles, zero UI frames). Positioned on the left half: the Orc Warrior girl leans casually on her battle axe with a cheeky teasing smirk, tapping her chin and dropping the B-tier DPS remark; beside her, the Human Warlock freezes in utter horror, dropping her empty soul shard pouch. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale filling ~65% of canvas height, leaving the right 48% pure white.

High-angle shot looking down at the Human Warlock girl kneeling on the ground, completely drained of life, on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background (no scenery, no floor shading, no gray backdrop, no panel borders, zero text, zero letters, zero digits, zero speech bubbles, zero UI frames). Squarely centered and filling ~80% of canvas height. Soul-leaving freeze-frame: blank white soulless eyes, slack parted mouth with a tiny pale cartoon soul puff floating upward, dark purple hood drooping, heavy vertical gloom lines.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
3시간 조각 캐고
소환·사탕 다 바쳤는데...
흑마는 대체 누가 하냐...
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic back-view shot on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background (no scenery, no floor shading, no gray backdrop, no panel borders, zero text, zero letters, zero digits, zero speech bubbles, zero UI frames). Positioned on the left half: the Human Warlock girl turns her back to the world, walking away slumped and hunched over, hugging her grumpy red plush imp doll tightly against her chest with gloomy dark comic swirls, looking back over her shoulder with empty dead-fish eyes; on the right, the Orc Warrior pats her back awkwardly with a sheepish sweat drop. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, right 48% pure white.
